lessons.title: Historical Catalyst Cases & Ethical Evolution
lessons.description: Examine the moral turning points in psychology and medicine: Tuskegee, Milgram's obedience experiments, and the Stanford Prison Study.

lessons.title: The Belmont Report & Institutional Review Boards (IRBs)
lessons.description: Master the three core ethical pillars—Respect for Persons, Beneficence, and Justice—and learn how IRBs evaluate research risk.

lessons.title: Informed Consent, Deception & Mandatory Debriefing
lessons.description: Navigate voluntary agreement, vulnerable populations, the strict conditions for using deception, and therapeutic debriefing.

lessons.title: Scientific Integrity & Non-Human Animal Research Ethics
lessons.description: Understand research fraud (falsification, fabrication), plagiarism, and ethical oversight of laboratory animals via IACUC and the 3Rs.
